observations.inspectedFrom: Seller photograph from Instagram post DXWbxTzjgY1 (2026-04-20), saved through the owner's browser session and supplied by the owner; original 1080x810 JPEG visually inspected
observations.observed: Seller photograph of three Indonesian Snorlax Hop cards side by side: HP 150, Ability Dermawan, Dynamic Press 140, Illus. OKACHEKE, MA3 136/193, (c)2026. Left: reverse holo with colourless-energy-star pattern. Middle: the standard printing, unsleeved. Right: reverse holo with Poke Ball pattern. Caption: 'rare Indonesian promo card featuring Snorlax with dazzling holo finish', linking eBay item 147259561075. Context frame for SPEC-0644; the two mirror variants are already established by U0787/U0792 and take no finish from this frame.

observations.observed: Indonesian Snorlax Hop MA3 136/193 standard printing, middle card of the wonderelic seller photograph SPEC-0643: HP 150, Ability Dermawan, Dynamic Press 140, Illus. OKACHEKE, (c)2026. Unsleeved; a rainbow foil sheen runs along the frame and through the artwork.

physicalObservation.basis: The collection owner determined on 2026-10-24 from this photograph that the card is holo: 'man erkennt ganz klar das die karte holo ist auf dem Bild, sie ist in keiner Hülle'. The seller photograph supports identity; the card is not the owner's.
